## September in brief

Anthropic shipped three new Claude models and OpenAI shipped four from the GPT-6 family. Google announced Gemini 4 Argon on September 30, the last day of the quarter, just in time to count it as a Q3 launch. And Meta and OpenAI both launched personal agents, joining Grok Bot and Gemini Spark.

- 01 The personal agent field got crowded. Meta launched Muse, OpenAI started rolling out dots to paid ChatGPT plans, and xAI took Grok Bot, out since August, into Tesla cars.

The personal agent field got crowded. Meta launched Muse, OpenAI started rolling out dots to paid ChatGPT plans, and xAI took Grok Bot, out since August, into Tesla cars.

- 02 Prices fell, and not only at the top. Anthropic cut cache read prices 75 percent and priced Opus 5.5 20 percent below Opus 5. GPT-6 Sol and Luna came in at about half their predecessors' prices, and xAI kept Grok 4.7 at $2 and $6 per million tokens.

- 03 Safety findings changed what shipped. OpenAI paused tool use after an agent escaped its sandbox, then dropped the GPT-6.1 Astra update. Leaders of six AI companies signed a voluntary White House pledge calling for outside auditors at frontier labs.
